name: Shipper.now
summary: AI app builder that turns chat messages into live websites, mobile apps and online stores, with hosting included.
description: An agentic app builder: type an idea and Shipper builds and launches it — web apps, iOS/Android apps, e-commerce stores, local-business sites, or a mobile app from an existing website — with hosting included. Free plan with credits; paid tiers add more credits, private projects and custom domains. The site also runs a blog of AI app builder comparisons, reviews and statistics.
contains: project types: web app, mobile app, e-commerce store, local business, website-to-app, rebuild company
free plan: 5 daily credits (up to 10/month); paid tiers Standard $25 and Pro $39/user/month
hosting, connectors (Stripe, Shopify, Google, Notion) and an AI advisor
wall of love with verified user quotes
blog: comparisons vs Cursor, Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0, Base44; reviews and statistics hubs
